name: antigravity-bridge
description: Bridge from Codex and other agents to the Antigravity CLI for review, adversarial review, and rescue passes.

interface.shortDescription: Use agy CLI for external passes.
interface.longDescription: Antigravity Bridge provides Codex skills that call the local agy CLI for ordinary reviews, adversarial challenge reviews, and rescue-style investigation or follow-up work. It keeps review runs read-only, normalizes Antigravity model names, and extracts final answers from Antigravity transcript logs when print mode does not write stdout.
defaultPrompt: Ask Antigravity to review my local changes.
Ask Antigravity for an adversarial review of this diff.
Ask Antigravity to rescue this failing investigation.
